terms_for_refunds_and_cancellations: Terms for refunds and cancellations of services provided by SavantX Technologies.
savantx_technologies_pvt_ltd_is: SavantX Technologies Pvt Ltd is committed to providing fair and transparent refund and cancellation policies. This policy outlines the terms and conditions for refunds and cancellations of our services.
navigate_through_our_refund_and: Navigate through our refund and cancellation policy sections
savantx_technologies_pvt_ltd_we: SavantX Technologies Pvt Ltd (“we,” “our,” or “us”) strives to provide exceptional services and customer satisfaction.
this_refund_and_cancellation_policy: This Refund and Cancellation Policy outlines the terms and conditions under which refunds and cancellations are processed. By engaging our services, you agree to the terms outlined in this policy. We reserve the right to modify this policy at any time, and changes will be effective immediately upon posting.
full_refunds_are_available_under: Full refunds are available under the following circumstances:
cancellation_within_24_hours_of: Cancellation within 24 hours of service initiation (before work begins)
service_not_delivered_as_per: Service not delivered as per agreed specifications
technical_failure_on_our_part: Technical failure on our part preventing service delivery
to_be_eligible_for_a: To be eligible for a refund, you must:
submit_a_refund_request_within: Submit a refund request within 30 days of payment
provide_valid_reason_and_supporting: Provide valid reason and supporting documentation
not_have_violated_terms_of: Not have violated terms of service agreement
you_may_cancel_your_service: You may cancel your service at any time, subject to the following terms:
t_100_refund_if_cancelled_before: 100% refund if cancelled before project initiation
t_75_refund_if_cancelled_during: 75% refund if cancelled during initial development phase
t_50_refund_if_cancelled_during: 50% refund if cancelled during mid-development phase
no_refund_if_cancelled_after: No refund if cancelled after 50% completion, deliverables provided
to_request_a_refund_please: To request a refund, please follow these steps:
with_your_order_number_and: with your order number and reason for refund.
we_will_review_your_request: We will review your request within 2-3 business days and verify eligibility.
upon_approval_refund_will_be: Upon approval, refund will be processed to your original payment method.
you_will_receive_email_confirmation: You will receive email confirmation once the refund is processed.
services_cancelled_due_to_client: Services cancelled due to client breach of contract
domain_registration_and_hosting_fees: Domain registration and hosting fees (if applicable)
partial_refunds_may_be_issued: Partial refunds may be issued in the following scenarios:
refund_amount_calculated_based_on: Refund amount calculated based on work completed and remaining deliverables.
if_project_scope_is_reduced: If project scope is reduced after initiation, refund for removed features.
refund_difference_if_service_is: Refund difference if service is downgraded or modified.
total_time_10_18_business: Total time: 10-18 business days from approval to receipt in your account
if_you_disagree_with_a: If you disagree with a refund decision, you may:
submit_additional_documentation_or_evide: Submit additional documentation or evidence for reconsideration within 7 days.
request_escalation_to_management_for: Request escalation to management for complex cases requiring further review.
we_aim_to_resolve_all: We aim to resolve all disputes fairly and within 14 business days.
savantx_technologies_pvt_ltd_reserves: SavantX Technologies Pvt Ltd reserves the right to modify this Refund and Cancellation Policy at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting on our website. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
your_continued_use_of_our: Your continued use of our services after any modifications constitutes acceptance of the updated policy. If you do not agree with any changes, you may cancel your service in accordance with the cancellation terms.
